title: setDispatcherHook does not settle pending mint-debt from the old dispatcher before swapping, stranding accrued debt

classification.assetImpact: Mint-debt accrued at the old dispatcher is orphaned from the staker contract's perspective when the owner swaps the hook. Recovery requires the owner re-pointing to the old dispatcher and calling pullAndRefresh, or an out-of-scope recovery path.
attackPath: 1. Old dispatcher has non-zero mint-debt accrued.
2. Owner calls setDispatcherHook(newHook) without first calling pullAndRefresh.
3. Subsequent _syncBudget calls pull from newHook, which has no accrued debt.
4. Old dispatcher's mint-debt is stranded until the owner manually re-points and pulls.
classification.likelihood: only triggerable by owner; depends on owner following or not following correct procedure.
classification.externalRequirements: Owner action with incorrect ordering (no preceding pullAndRefresh).

justification: Centralization (C) bucket. Only the owner can call setDispatcherHook. The defect manifests exclusively on owner action with incorrect ordering and is recoverable by the owner via re-pointing. Classic admin-footgun pattern that C4 places in the Centralization bundle rather than in Medium/High. The fix is a one-line code change (call _syncBudget() before swapping), so the QA/centralization report should recommend it. Not Low because there is no permissionless trigger and no automatic drift; the issue is entirely gated on owner behavior.
